summary: This was the best structural week the review loop has had and the worst week for the gap between finding things and fixing them. Every weekday rotation slot ran on its assigned day for the first time since the Tuesday gap opened, the Gnosis leak that carried a BLOCK for two consecutive constellation reports is closed and independently re-verified live this morning, open actions fell 662 to 564, and all eleven repositories are clean with nothing unpushed. Against that, six live user-facing breaks are in production right now and four of them already have a written fix that never reached the running system. The queue took in 96 items and finished 31 over the same seven days, none of the 369 pending items is marked safe for unattended work, the hourly drain is switched off, and 86 items sit blocked on Kane with the oldest decision 74 days old.

topActions.label: REDACTED: this text named a weakness and the file it lives in, which together are an address. Severity and project are kept; the location is in the project's own report under X:\PortfolioOps.
BLOCK: five private artifacts removed from the public hub tree are still fetchable anonymously from its git history. Rule on a history rewrite or a written acceptance.
Guard the project allowlist with an own-property check and add an uncaught-exception fallback; one unauthenticated request kills the server and every run in flight.
Deploy the billing sync fix in commit 0a877c2; until it ships a failed entitlement write is still reported as success and dropped permanently.
REDACTED: a high severity cross-cutting action names a project that is private by rule. Full detail is in the constellation report; withheld from the public copy.
Fix the import duplicate key: distinct same-day charges with matching merchant, amount and description are silently merged and dropped, three real rows already lost.
Restore queue throughput and stop the retention step deleting sole reports; zero of 369 pending items are drain-eligible and three sole copies died on three consecutive nights.
Spend sessions ruling rather than reviewing: 33 decisions blocked on Kane, oldest 74 days, five written up and ready in the week brief.
Playability pass before further engineering: no reachable win condition, five dead power buildings, only the command post is attackable, three save paths desync.
Rule which skill snapshot is authoritative and regenerate from source once; seven projects carry the finding and two found live corruption in the loaded copy.
